description: This file defines the Drupal user entity class, including its properties, methods, and configuration for handling user data within Drupal.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents the Drupal user entity with properties and methods for user management, including roles, permissions, and account status.

methods.name: isNew
methods.description: Checks if the user entity is new (not yet saved).

methods.name: label
methods.description: Returns the display label for the user, typically the username.

methods.name: preSave
methods.description: Performs operations before saving the user entity, such as role filtering and timezone setting.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Performs operations after saving, such as session management and notification emails.

methods.name: postDelete
methods.description: Handles cleanup after user deletion, such as removing user data.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Retrieves the list of roles assigned to the user.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific role.

methods.name: addRole
methods.description: Adds a role to the user.

methods.name: removeRole
methods.description: Removes a role from the user.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the user has a specific permission.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the user's hashed password.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the user's password.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the user's email address.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the user's email address.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the account creation timestamp.

methods.name: getLastAccessedTime
methods.description: Returns the last access timestamp.

methods.name: setLastAccessTime
methods.description: Sets the last access timestamp.

methods.name: getLastLoginTime
methods.description: Returns the last login timestamp.

methods.name: setLastLoginTime
methods.description: Sets the last login timestamp.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the user account is active.

methods.name: isBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the user account is blocked.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the user account.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Blocks the user account.

methods.name: getTimeZone
methods.description: Returns the user's timezone.

methods.name: getPreferredLangcode
methods.description: Returns the user's preferred language code.

methods.name: getPreferredAdminLangcode
methods.description: Returns the user's preferred admin language code.

methods.name: getInitialEmail
methods.description: Returns the initial email used during account creation.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the user is authenticated (not anonymous).

methods.name: isAnonymous
methods.description: Checks if the user is anonymous.

methods.name: getAccountName
methods.description: Returns the user's account name.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name for the user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username.

methods.name: setExistingPassword
methods.description: Sets an existing password for verification.

methods.name: checkExistingPassword
methods.description: Checks if the provided password matches the existing one.

methods.name: getAnonymousUser
methods.description: Returns the singleton anonymous user entity.

methods.name: baseFieldDefinitions
methods.description: Defines the base fields for the user entity.

methods.name: getAllowedTimezones
methods.description: Returns list of allowed timezone identifiers.

methods.name: getAllowedConfigurableLanguageCodes
methods.description: Returns list of allowed language codes for configuration.
